monetization.reason: No approved affiliate program or tracking ID is configured in the repository. The purchase-intent dosing-capsule guide remains brand-neutral except for clearly identified manufacturer instructions and uses no commercial product link or image.

image_qa.note: All three new pages use image-free editorial layouts, tables, checklists, and source cards. No editorial, cultivar, product, affiliate, stock, or generated image was added or changed.

search_console.decision: The September 14–October 11 report showed 1,373 impressions, four clicks, 0.3% CTR, and average position 33.5. Stem Cell CBG was the only supported position 4–20 content signal with meaningful volume: 18 impressions, one click, and position 6.2. The one Data-led page expands the distinct plant-chemotype and lot-evidence question without cloning that cultivar intent. One-impression query rows, four ashtray impressions, and the isolated Oklahoma-law click at position 66.9 were deliberately ignored as too weak or irrelevant. The two remaining pages preserve portfolio breadth.

authority.action: Published a citation-worthy three-question evidence system: a five-layer CBG chemotype record grounded in primary genetics and official compound records, a model-compatibility capsule matrix grounded in manufacturer instructions and CPSC recalls, and an intoxication/impairment/detection decision table grounded in CDC, NHTSA, SAMHSA, and Poison Control sources. Reciprocal contextual links connect each asset to established cluster pages. No outreach was sent or logged.
